text: A stack trace's most useful line is the last one.
explanation: The topmost frame is where the exception was constructed, and the most useful line is usually the topmost one in *your* code — everything above it is library internals and everything below is how you arrived. Reading downward tells you the story of the call chain. Chapter 28 adds the other half: an exception rethrown without its cause has destroyed this information, which is why passing the cause is a one-argument habit worth forming.
